claim: The unsubscripted rho of the deposited record -- the exponent of the leading Borel-plane singularity, an indicial exponent in the uniformiser u = sqrt z -- has been removed from section 1 as a symbol of this paper. It is named only in the correspondence footnote, as the deposited convention, because the paper states no result about it and its relation to the growth exponent s was anchored only at d = 2.
label: INSPECTED

claim: Section 1's sentence stating that rho carries two meanings was false about the paper. rho occurs in three senses, none of which is the Borel-plane exponent that sentence called its primary meaning: rho_j for the characteristic roots of the homogeneous recurrence in section 2, rho as the growth base in the normal-solution form in section 2, and rho_pm for the finite singular points of System B in section 3. The sentence had already been repaired once, at CT-S38, from a stronger false claim; the repair replaced it with a weaker false claim.
label: VERIFIED

claim: Section 7 used rho as an undefined step-size scale, writing the error bar as obtained from step halving at h = rho/4 against h = rho/8. No definition of that rho exists anywhere in the paper or in the cited claim. It was removed in favour of the step counts the claim does record, so that the sentence asserts only what its evidence supports; no value was invented to fill the gap.
label: INSPECTED

claim: Section 2's Newton--Puiseux diagram has been unified to Newton polygon, the name section 1 defines and the name used by van der Put--Saito and the Katz-invariant literature. The paper previously defined one name and used another, which no citation check and no build can detect.
label: INSPECTED

claim: Section 3's normal potential, written R = 1/4 a^2 + 1/2 a' - b, has been unified to the general form R = 1/4 P^2 + 1/2 P' - Q already stated in section 1, with section 3's case recorded as the specialisation (P, Q) = (a, b). The two were the same construction at different specialisations, so the repair unifies rather than separates them.
label: INSPECTED

claim: The ruled separation of P as a determinant from P as the first-order coefficient of a scalar operator required no edit: the paper nowhere writes a bare P for the determinant a^2 + bc. Section 8 already writes -det A and names it. Every bare P in the 13 assembled files is the scalar operator's coefficient, a quotation, or a subscripted variant. The item is discharged by verification, not by repair.
label: VERIFIED

claim: The moduli space was written three ways -- upright M with subscript in section 0, bare calligraphic M in section 9, and calligraphic M with subscript in the appendix A passage quoted verbatim from van der Put--Saito. The quoted form is the source's own and is authoritative, so sections 0 and 9 were unified to it. The section 0 change has no rendered-text signature, since pdftotext maps both glyphs to M; the section 9 change does, and the gate caught the author's initial misdeclaration of both as invisible.
label: INSPECTED

claim: Section 5 reintroduced r_1, in a fifth sense -- the coefficient of 1/x in the expansion of the normal potential -- after section 1's correspondence footnote names the deposited record's r_1 as ambiguous and the roots were renamed to nu_i precisely to retire it. The symbol was retired by writing its value inline. The displayed consequence is unchanged and was checked arithmetically: with c_0^2 = 1/3 the display reads -1 -+ sqrt3/18 before and after.
label: INSPECTED

claim: Section 5 used a bare A for the scalar residue of a Riccati solution, while a bare A denotes a two-by-two matrix everywhere else in the paper, including nineteen lines later in the same section. It was renamed to kappa, which the census confirms was unused. This is the only residue item resolved by renaming rather than by stating a convention.
label: INSPECTED

claim: Section 1 gains a paragraph stating the convention for each of the six deferred letters M, A, L, u, beta and r, each with its discriminator -- font, subscript, or locality to one computation -- following section 1's own precedent of resolving a collision by stating the convention where the objects are already distinguishable.
label: INSPECTED

claim: The deferred residue was re-measured against the assembled paper rather than inherited from CT-S38, whose symbol index was built over theorem.tex and section 1 alone, before sections 2 to 10 and the appendices existed. Over the pre-pass corpus -- 13 files, 138537 characters -- the census returns 185 occurrences of the six letters across 6 letters, of which 61 are A. Restricting to math spans is what makes that number mean anything: unrestricted, the reader counts the English article, a defect caught by the mask's negative control before any figure was reported.
label: VERIFIED

claim: The rendered-text gate compares the token SEQUENCE of the pre-pass and post-pass documents, not the whitespace-stripped character multiset used at CT-S38, which is anagram-blind and cannot distinguish a rename from its reverse. It passes with 20 differing regions, every one accounted for, and all 8 control arms CAUGHT -- including the arm that transposes two symbols into an anagram of the same characters.
label: VERIFIED

claim: The repaired paper builds at 39 pages with 0 errors, 0 undefined references and 0 multiply-defined labels, converged over four passes. The assembly gate passes over the repaired files at 13 sections, 124 labels and 76 referenced targets, and its 7 mutant arms are all CAUGHT. The gate was repointed from the pre-pass copies before it was run; left as staged it would have certified the unrepaired document.
label: VERIFIED

claim: CT-S43's recorded page count of 37 is not reproducible from CT-S43's own inputs. Rebuilding that session's exact layout, jobname and files -- verified byte-identical, preamble included -- converges at 38 pages over three passes. CT-S43's paper.log therefore records a build of an earlier state of the files than the ones it shipped, and the gate did not see it because it read the log rather than rebuilding. No file of CT-S43 is altered; this claim supersedes the page count only.
label: VERIFIED

claim: The gate's declaration of intended changes was completed iteratively against the diff it certifies, so it is not a blind pre-registration and its authority rests on its control arms rather than on the declaration. Two declarations were found wrong by the gate itself: the moduli-space repair was declared invisible when half of it is visible, and section 5's numeric delta was declared without being computed and was simply wrong. Both were corrected against the measurement, not the expectation.
label: INSPECTED

claim: This session's first symbol census was run mid-pass, against a tree that some repairs had already reached and others had not. It reported figures that match neither the pre-pass corpus nor the repaired one, and that state no longer exists, so the measurement is not reproducible. The defect was invisible while the census defaulted to the session root: it surfaced only when the script was re-run and its own output changed underneath a claim that quoted it. The census now names its corpus explicitly, prepass or repaired, and resolves it POSITIVELY by a marker each tree carries and the other does not -- refs/section1.tex must still carry the pre-repair rho sentence, and the session root must carry the repaired conventions paragraph -- so that a census cannot report a number for a corpus nobody asked about. Three control arms, including a negative arm in which a semantically neutral edit must NOT fire the guard, all CAUGHT.
label: VERIFIED

claim: The emitter's own numeric check is weaker than it appears, and this is recorded as a limit rather than repaired. It confirms a number by searching the cited evidence file for the digit string anywhere in the file, so a line number, a context quotation or an unrelated figure satisfies it. The superseded text of S44-11 cited a count for the letter A that the check accepted solely because the same digits occur as a line number in the census listing -- the check passed for the wrong reason, on a figure that was in fact unreproducible. The general form is the one already recorded for textual proximity: presence of a numeral in a file does not establish that the file evidences that quantity. A sound version would resolve each figure to the summary line that reports it.
label: INSPECTED
